title: Normalize Mixed Separator Paths Across Windows and macOS
taskDescription: On Windows, media imported from network shares (UNC paths e.g. \\server\share\video.mp4) or using mixed separators (C:/Users\name/video.mp4) causes Rust IPC commands to fail path validation. Update nativeCore.ts path conversion to normalize separators and maintain valid drive letters.
expectedBehavior: All platform paths normalize cleanly before transmission to Tauri IPC commands without losing Windows drive letters or UNC prefixes.
architecturalConstraints: No hardcoded string replacements using only '/' or '\'
Must preserve POSIX absolute paths on macOS and Linux
Must respect Tauri path security capability scope
acceptanceCriteria: Unit test covers Windows UNC paths, drive letter paths, POSIX paths, and mixed separators
